summary: test(pairing): open the Android v2 QR in a regular tab
description:
Because:
- The Sync Debug hook runs app-services' own OAuth-start, so the test
  covered the URL-params fallback rather than pair_oauth_start.
- A real v2 device scans with the native camera, which reaches Firefox
  as a plain VIEW intent.

This commit:
- adds AndroidSupplicant.openPairingUrl and points the v2 spec at it.
- restricts dialog dismissal to native widgets, so it cannot tap the
  supplicant card's own Cancel button and abort the flow.
- asserts the paired device appears in Connected Services.
- reports the last seen URL when waitForUrlContaining times out.
